entries.label: Router Conditional Approvals
entries.text: Netgear, Inc.’s listed conditional approval covers its Nighthawk consumer mesh, mobile, and standalone routers in the R, RAX, RAXE, RS, MK, MR, M, and MH series; Orbi consumer mesh, mobile, and standalone routers in the RBK, RBE, RBR, RBRE, LBR, LBK, and CBK series; and CAX cable gateways and CM cable modems. The approval runs from April 14, 2026, through October 1, 2027.
